MEDIA_EDITOR.TITLE: Edit media
MEDIA_EDITOR.VIDEO_BITRATE_RETRY: The encoder exceeded the bitrate limit. Adjusting the video once more before uploading.

MEDIA_EDITOR.UPLOAD_WAITING: No update for {seconds}s. Waiting for upload; do not close or resend.

MEDIA_EDITOR.TEXT_HINT: Type to add text or edit the selected text
MEDIA_EDITOR.CROP_HINT: Drag edges or corners to adjust the crop, then apply.
MEDIA_EDITOR.DRAW_HINT: Draw on the image with your finger or mouse.
MEDIA_EDITOR.CAPTION: Add a caption…
MEDIA_EDITOR.CAPTION_LIMIT: A caption exceeds this channel's limit.
MEDIA_EDITOR.UNDEFINED_VARIABLES: Resolve undefined caption variables before sending.
MEDIA_EDITOR.UNSUPPORTED_FILE: Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or MP4, MOV, WebM and MKV videos in this editor. Send other documents through the regular flow after closing the editor.

MEDIA_EDITOR.INVALID_VIDEO: Unable to read this video, or the selected time range is invalid.

MEDIA_EDITOR.VIDEO_UNSUPPORTED: This browser could not convert the video with compatible video and audio. Nothing was uploaded.
MEDIA_EDITOR.IMAGE_ERROR: Unable to prepare the image on this device. Try a smaller image.
MEDIA_EDITOR.SERVER_FALLBACK: Send the original to the server worker (discards trimming and audio changes)
MEDIA_EDITOR.UPLOAD_FAILED: Upload failed. This file was not sent to the conversation. You may try again.
MEDIA_EDITOR.SEND_FAILED: Sending failed after the message was added to the conversation. Retry from its bubble; remaining attachments are still here.
